source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 is a GPU sensor: load the GPU driver first, then run `sudo ipmitool sdr elist` + `sudo ipmitool sensor list`; reading should change with GPU temp. Needs the GPU driver loaded + a temp change (workload) to observe.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the sdr/sensor-list output for TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 showing the reading changes as temp changes + SEL assert/deassert log; user confirms thresholds/spec.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: warming the GPU via workload raises heat; control cooling. Pass/Fail judged by user.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

original_test_intent: With the required accelerator driver active, exercise and independently verify the four GPU-baseboard PCB temperature locations through approved warning and critical thresholds, including correct SEL/protection behavior and full board/device recovery.
original_method: An engineer initializes the GPU stack and uses workload or another approved thermal method while IPMI observes PCB1 through PCB4; the source does not locate those sensors or show that one GPU workload creates the required temperature profile at all four sites.
manual_activity: An engineer maps PCB1-4 to exact coordinates and nearby components on the actual board revision, selects a workload, chamber or localized fixture that can safely demonstrate each location, positions independent probes, and owns abort and recovery.
required_inputs: GPU baseboard revision and PCB1-4 physical coordinates, SDR records and stable accelerator UUID/PCI BDF mapping
nearby GPU, memory, VRM/power stage, retimer/switch or connector domains for each sensor
validated driver, firmware, vendor telemetry and workload/fixture versions
per-location units, accuracy, normal range, warning/critical limits, tolerance, hysteresis and SEL event data
stimulus-to-location coupling and thermal-gradient plan with ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
co-located calibrated probes, power/fan/device/link telemetry, log retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer physical positions from PCB1-4 numbering or assume a core-heavy GPU workload adequately heats all board sites.
Do not apply localized heat until nearby temperature-sensitive components, traces, connectors and power stages are identified and their limits are included.

Continuously monitor four BMC channels, co-located probes, GPU/memory/power telemetry, clocks/throttle reasons, XID, PCIe/fabric health, fans and host; abort on gradient overshoot, rail anomaly, device/link error or cooling failure.
Preserve the first location-specific SEL, XID, AER, power and driver failure evidence; do not clear logs or auto-retry.
Stop stimulus, restore uniform cooling and verify each board region plus all nearby components and accelerator links recover.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind PCB1-4 samples to their physical coordinates, SDR identities, nearby component domains and stable accelerator identity.
Run only the approved workload or monitor the engineer-operated chamber/fixture while collecting synchronized BMC/SEL, co-located probe, accelerator, power, fan and host evidence.
Produce four independent location rows for temperature gradient, warning/critical assert/deassert, protection timing, cooldown and recovery; one PCB sensor cannot satisfy another.
Do not invent coordinates, move probes, apply physical heat, exceed the envelope, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board map, sensor/probe placement, nearby-component limits, stack, per-location stimulus/coupling plan, event/protection matrix and recovery.
Operate physical stimulus with oversight and emergency abort authority.
Evaluate board-level anomalies and issue per-location plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The driver/workload outline is partial, but SDR and sensor lists alone cannot locate PCB1-4, prove workload coupling, retrieve SEL events or demonstrate four-site recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection synchronized with a physical PCB map, co-located probes, vendor accelerator and board-power telemetry, stable device identity and an approved location-coupled stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, PCB1~4 range, IPMI commands, dynamic threshold requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain; the Project thermal plan controls actual sequence and dwell.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map and instrument all four board sites, baseline the spatial gradient, apply an approved workload/chamber/local condition for each required site, correlate SEL/protection, then restore uniform cooling and prove board/device recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU baseboard revision, component population, sensor placement and airflow/cooling design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, GPU UUID/BDF, VBIOS/firmware, driver, BMC/SDR, probe, fixture and workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor board layout and thermal sensor map, component limits, SEL mapping and accelerator/baseboard recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical coordinates, co-located probes, spatial-gradient and nearby-component evidence instead of treating every PCB channel as generic GPU temperature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A GPU die temperature rise or a subset of changing PCB sensors cannot satisfy the explicit all-PCB1~4 criterion.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board/sensor map, qualified probes and stimulus coupling, per-location limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Localized board heating can exceed a nearby VRM, memory, retimer or connector limit before the target BMC sensor reaches its threshold; a global workload may leave remote sites untested.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may use workload, chamber or qualified local-air stimulus and may mark an unimplemented sensor not applicable only with board-population evidence. Every grouped, omitted or unreachable location needs a documented coverage and equivalence disposition.
expected_evidence: board revision plus PCB1-4 physical coordinate, SDR, nearby-component and accelerator identity map
co-located probe calibration and approved workload/chamber/fixture coupling and abort plan
timestamped four-channel BMC and probe temperatures with spatial gradients, accelerator/power/clocks/throttling/fan state
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert entries separately attributed to every applicable PCB location
XID, driver, PCIe/fabric link, rail/power and host-console evidence
uniform cooldown, per-location deassertion, nearby-component/device/link/host/BMC recovery and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Code Wistron-BMC-00071-V003 is reused at row 1503 for unrelated MB-CPLD WebUI flash. Row 781 remains the four-location PCB thermal variant by physical identity; Project board mapping resolves its spatial scope without changing or merging Master rows.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Master clearly requires dynamic verification of all four PCB temperature channels. Physical coordinates, board population, driver package, limits and safe stimulus-to-location coupling are supplyable Project inputs, so attended setup with automated evidence collection is conditionally feasible.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining board-level safety gates.

review_improvement: Converts PCB1-4 into four spatially accountable thermal locations and prevents GPU die heating or a single responding sensor from masking untested board regions.
independent_technical_reasoning: The PCB range and all-channel criterion establish the test purpose; only the platform-specific coordinates and coupling method are missing. Those are normal Project execution inputs. Because sensor response, board gradient and nearby-component health can be monitored automatically after engineer setup, the case is conditional rather than permanently blocked.
